description: This PHP class 'Paths' provides methods for retrieving various filesystem paths used within the SuiteCRM project, including container file paths, library paths, custom library paths, and project paths.

classes.name: Paths
classes.description: A class that standardizes access to key filesystem locations in the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: getContainersFilePath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to the containers.php file within the API directory.

methods.name: getLibraryPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the library directory.

methods.name: getCustomLibraryPath
methods.description: Calculates and returns the path to the custom library directory by replacing the project path in the library path with a 'custom' subdirectory.

methods.name: getProjectPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the root of the project directory.
